mechanism_narrative: The recent upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility, observed over the last week, indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity that will continue to drive retail and recreation visits higher over the next four weeks.

candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds 20 points above baseline in the most recent week (t-0w)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility does not increase over the next 14 days, despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 20 points.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility over the next 28 days increases, despite WORKPLACES remaining below its t-2w level and RESIDENTIAL remaining stable.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility over the next 28 days does not increase, despite PARKS mobility continuing its upward trend in a reopening environment.

candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES < -20 points below baseline for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility over the next 14 days increases, despite WORKPLACES remaining below -20% for two consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility over the next 7 days decreases, despite GROCERY_PHARM showing a strong increase and RESIDENTIAL remaining stable.
